name: Pealreelin
description: Open the school's first form with a throw from the lead hand while the off hand holds the slack.

name: Prismtine
description: Hold a loop of cord in both hands before the chest so one hand covers where the other cannot.

name: Tinegrace
description: Shuffle forward on the trailing foot so the school's measured spacing is kept from first step.

name: Thralltine
description: Two cords fall over the wrist in turn and a pulse of qi sets both before the foe can pull free.

name: Squall Cordknot
description: Turn the cord in a counter whirl that sends a chop or thrust back along the line it came by.

name: Matchless Loopcast
description: The dart lashes the foe's guard arm and returns at once to meet the cord in the off hand.

name: Beguiling Cordloop
description: Two matched snares are set on the ground between student and foe and spring together on a step.

name: Spooldecree
description: Drive qi down both cords at once so the dart pierces where a single line would glance.

name: Pulsarspool
description: Both cords drive the dart through plate in a straight judgment that the foe cannot turn aside.

name: Tenetspool
description: The school's six linked throws and wraps run in fixed count and each answers the guard that the last one drew.

name: Squallreelin
description: Lob the dart to the height of the hawk's climb before the first stoop of the form.

name: Consecrated Cordwinder
description: Spread both arms and cord like wings to cover the flanks against a rushing foe.

name: Deluge Retrieve
description: Bank the body in a curved step like a hawk turning so the dart swings clear.

name: Imperial Dartblade
description: Dive the dart from above the guard and lash across the brow with a snap of qi.

name: Unbending Tailring
description: A tether settles about a wrist like a talon and tightens as the foe begins to pull.

name: Pall Ringend
description: Climb the dart high as if for a stoop and drop the strike low instead.

name: Immaculate Flickhand
description: Keep the eyes lowered as if hooded and turn a blow aside the moment it commits.

name: Radiance Dartneck
description: Qi gathers in the dart at the top of the climb and it falls to pierce the foe's guard.

name: Sigil Cordlength
description: Hang a cord loop high above a path so it falls on whoever walks beneath.

name: Thunderclap Snapback
description: Streak the dart straight down the cord's line and rend through plate in one unbroken dive.

name: Matchless Vacuum Whipout
description: Hold the dart high until the foe's guard drops and then let it fall and wrap in the school's finishing stoop.

name: Prismspool
description: Cast the dart so it winds in a slow curve like a river's course to reach the foe.

name: Peal Flickhand
description: Take a blow into a meander of cord and let it spend itself in the turns.

name: Skyborne Spiralcast
description: Skim along the foe's side as a current skims a bank and keep the cord clear.

name: Taut Tailring
description: A soft loop of cord is cast so lightly that the foe's wrist is in it before he feels it.

name: Spoolseal
description: Bend the cord round the foe's ankle and pull to draw him along the school's chosen line.

name: Deflecting Darttip
description: Hold the cord in an oxbow loop before the body and let it shed blows round to the sides.

name: Magnificent Ringend
description: Lash the dart along a flowing arc so it strikes with the whole length of the cord behind it.

name: Fettering Retrieve
description: Wrap slowly and heavily like silt settling until the foe's limbs are weighted and slow.

name: Tempestuous Darttip
description: Sweep the charged cord low across a wide front like a flood spreading over flat ground.

name: Lurking Cordknot
description: Set a coiled snare in the ground so it turns and tightens round the first foot to touch it.

name: Magnificent Reelin
description: Bring the cord round in the river's great bend and rend the guard with the dart's whole weight.

name: Choral Destiny Snapback
description: The school's full river course of casts and wraps flows from source to mouth in one unbroken count.

name: Thunderclap Whipout
description: Sight along the tether to the foe's centerline and cast on the line sighted.

name: Sound Dartblade
description: Hold the tether like a rim round the body so blows meet its edge and not the student.

name: Bedrock Cordwinder
description: Switch from the first track to the second in a single balanced step.

name: Fettering Cordlength
description: Cross two tethers over the foe's wrists and draw them against each other with a pulse of qi.

name: Squall Cordloop
description: Lash low along the floor of the fighting ground so the dart takes the foe's lower leg.

name: Imperious Reelin
description: Pull a snared foe toward the rim of the practice ground and off his planted stance.

name: Statute Tailring
description: Turn two cords on opposing tracks so that anything entering one is thrown out by the other.

name: Guileful Dartneck
description: Spread a pattern of snares on the ground so that the foe must cross one to leave.

name: Radiance Loopcast
description: Cleave through the foe's track with a charged dart that holds its line to the end.

name: Radiance Snapback
description: Two charged tracks meet on the guard and the dart breaks it clean at the junction.

name: Destiny Darttip
description: The basin's round of paired casts and pulls is run in the school's fixed order from rim to floor.

name: Reelinbanner
description: Lead with a cast that shows the hawk's height and keeps the basin's low line behind it.

name: Deluge Ringend
description: Turn along the basin's rim with the cord out to sweep a blow past the body.

name: Feather Cordlength
description: Step into the foe's blind side under the cover of the dart's passing shadow.

name: Thrall Flickhand
description: Circle the dart round the foe like a hawk and let the cord close its wrap.

name: Illustrious Reelin
description: Throw against the practice basin's edge so the rebound takes the foe from the unwatched side.

name: Squallpluck
description: Spiral the cord upward on a rising field so a strike glides up and away.

name: Tinebanner
description: The charged dart plunges through the foe's guard like a hawk dropping into a basin.

name: Artful Dartneck
description: Lay a cord mesh over the floor of the ground so its edges rise and close on those inside.

name: Ethereal Cordknot
description: Flash to the far rim of the cord's reach and strike with the dart as the stoop lands.

name: Orchestral Tenet Whipout
description: The school's final form joins the hawk's stoop to the basin's wrap in one sequence the school guards.

name: Peal Loopcast
description: Open from the Core with the first cord thrown and the second held back in reserve.

name: Cordloop Covenant
description: Feed the guard cord from the Core so it stays firm against heavy blows.

name: Squallspool
description: Time each step to the pulse of the Core so the two cords never foul on the move.

name: Sigil Dartblade
description: Settle two loops over the foe's arm in one soft movement from the Core's turn.

name: Thrumtroth
description: Hold a steady orbit of cord by the Core's turning so the arms are free to act.

name: Quenched Spiralcast
description: Cross both cords in a lash that arrives on the foe's guard from two angles.

name: Sigilpluck
description: A thrum from the Core runs down the cord and stiffens a wrap about a limb.

name: Squall Cordwinder
description: Spin a cord from the Core to throw a heavy blade off the body's line.

name: Plucktriumph
description: A surge from the Core drives the dart down in a plunge that splits a raised shield.

name: Artful Tailring
description: Set a snare of twin cords charged from the Core that tightens when its ground is crossed.

name: Paramount Dartblade
description: Drive both cords from the Core through one point and breach the foe's guard and plate together.

name: Symphonic Season Cordlength
description: The school's core sequence runs both cords through every form in one breath of the Core.

name: Lordly Retrieve
description: Cast the first sworn throw of the school straight down the line the student has taken.

name: Stolid Darttip
description: Hold a guard loop on the wind side so blows must cross it before they reach the body.

name: Wraithlike Cordloop
description: Shuffle across open ground with the cord trailing low and ready.

name: Sigil Loopcast
description: A sworn loop falls on the wrist and qi holds it shut however the foe turns.

name: Pealpluck
description: Spin the cord like a gust broken on a post so that strikes turn aside.

name: Bedrock Spiralcast
description: The dart lashes across the guard with the force of an oath kept to its mark.

name: Latchspool
description: Peg a field of snares over open ground so a running foe is caught without warning.

name: Tineverdict
description: Let the sworn wind carry the charged dart through a guard that stands in its lee.

name: Pulsarreelin
description: Cast in the full gale and rend the foe's plate with the dart's whole sworn weight.

name: Orchestral Dartneck Edict
description: The school's sworn round of casts and wraps follows the wind's course from lull to gale.

name: Noble Whipout
description: Open at the edge of the ground with a cast along the rim's line.

name: Bedrock Cordknot
description: Guard with the cord low and the weight back like one who walks a plateau's lip.

name: Vigor Spiralcast
description: Slide the foot along the rim to feel the edge before the weight comes down.

name: Thunderclap Ringend
description: Throw over the drop and haul the dart back so it lashes the foe on the return.

name: Steel Cordwinder
description: Hold the cord anchored over the drop and lean against the push of a pressing foe.

name: Commanding Reelin
description: Drag the foe by a snared ankle toward the edge as a gust drags a falling leaf.

name: Inviolate Dartneck
description: Shear a blade along the cord's rim so it passes the body at the edge.

name: Latching Dartblade
description: A cord hidden along the lip lifts at the foe's step and takes the heel.

name: Imperial Flickhand
description: Throw over the drop and call the charged dart up beneath the foe's lifted guard.

name: Haemaltine
description: Bring the dart down in a fall that breaks the guard and the footing together.

name: Grand Whipout
description: The school's last form closes the edge against the foe through a held sequence of drops and wraps.

name: Prismpluck
description: Cast the first form of the oath so that the dart goes where the student has sworn it to go.

name: Steelthrum
description: Hold the guard to the sworn line and let it break the first blow that crosses it.

name: Fleet Reelin
description: Take each step on the kept heading and refuse the feint that would turn it.

name: Sigilthrum
description: Offer a loop at the foe's wrist and close it only when the pull comes.

name: Hobbling Cordlength
description: Cinch the wrist with the oath's whole tension so the grip cannot be broken.

name: Bedrock Darttip
description: Turn the cord on the kept bearing as an unbroken screen against darts and thrusts.

name: Steel Snapback
description: Press the dart's point forward on the sworn line with no turn of the wrist.

name: Tinetroth
description: Draw a snared foe one pace inside the cord's turn by an even pull.

name: Latchtine
description: Spread a net on the sworn ground that closes only on those who break the line.

name: Prism Tailring
description: Drive the charged dart down the oath's line until it stands through the guard.

name: Vacuum Snapback
description: Cord and dart keep the oath together through plate in a single breach of the guard.

name: Harmonious Season Loopcast
description: The school's whole order of oath forms runs in sequence and no form is dropped before the last.

name: Pluckbanner
description: Lead the exchange with a cast on the bearing and let the gale add its push.

name: Delugepluck
description: Turn the guard into the gale so a blow is pushed wide by wind and cord together.

name: Evanescent Flickhand
description: Advance on a held heading and let the dart ride behind in the gale's lee.

name: Triumphant Cordloop
description: Lash the dart along the bearing with a gust behind it to land on the guard arm.

name: Millstone Spiralcast
description: Wrap a limb on the bearing and drag the foe the way the wind blows.

name: Peal Cordknot
description: Spiral the cord against the gale so a strike meets a spinning wind and slides away.

name: Enshrined Tailring
description: Hold the cord in a screen along the heading while the gale keeps it taut.

name: Retribution Cordlength
description: Peg a snare along the gale's line so a foe running with the wind is caught.

name: Flickhand Banner
description: Run the charged dart down the bearing so the point arrives where the foe must stand.

name: Thunderclap Retrieve
description: Rupture the guard with the dart sent down the bearing in the full push of the gale.

name: Destiny Ringend
description: The school's course holds a bearing through a gale of linked casts and wraps to the last.

name: Unrivaled Cordwinder
description: Lead with a long cast under the open sky and let the foe see only the dart.

name: Pealthrum
description: Turn the cord in the clear air so that no blow can come from behind cover.

name: Soundless Dartneck
description: Step along the sky's edge of the ground with the cord trailing wide.

name: Thrallpluck
description: A loop falls on the wrist from above as unseen as a bird from the sky.

name: Stalwart Darttip
description: Turn the cord like the arms of a windmill and let it turn missiles away.

name: Thunderclap Cordknot
description: Drop the dart from the sky's height and lash it across the foe's crown.

name: Retribution Cordwinder
description: Cast a net of cord over an open plain so it falls on riders and runners alike.

name: Pulsar Dartblade
description: Plunge the charged dart from the full height of the open sky onto the foe's guard.

name: Season Spiralcast
description: Flash across the open ground on the cord's line and strike as the dart arrives with the wind.

name: Harmonious Retrieve
description: The school's last round spreads its casts and wraps across the whole open sky around the foe.

name: Radiance Cordloop
description: Open from the Core with the long cord loosed to its full reach.

name: Thrumvow
description: Hold the guard from the Core's turning so the wind and blows glance off it.

name: Squall Whipout
description: Set each step to the Core's heading and the long cord follows without a snag.

name: Ringend Pledge
description: Settle the long loop on the foe's arm with a movement drawn out of the Core.

name: Undefiled Cordwinder
description: The Core keeps the long cord in orbit so the student may act with open hands.

name: Inferno Retrieve
description: Lash the long cord with the Core's push and the gale's pull in the same beat.

name: Authoritative Loopcast
description: Wrap the foe along a bearing held steady by the Core and draw him in.

name: Parity Flickhand
description: Parry with a long cord turned from the Core so the blow slides downwind.

name: Cordknot Banner
description: Plunge the Core-charged dart through a gale and through the guard in its path.

name: Tineseal
description: Lay a long snare charged from the Core that tightens on any who cross its line.

name: Steel Dartblade
description: Drive the long cord from the Core through one point and breach the foe's whole guard.

name: Symphonic Whipout
description: The school's long sequence carries the Core's qi through every cord form in a single held breath.
